metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: was put in charge of YouTube for a month

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in this most critical of times

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: where YouTube actually has incredible amounts of power

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to educate the populace, to give power of knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to the populace such that they can reform institutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What would you do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: How would you run YouTube?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, unfortunately, or fortunately,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: this is actually quite simple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The founders, the American founders

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: settled on a counterintuitive formulation

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that people should be free to say anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: They should be free from the government

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: blocking them from doing so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: They did not imagine that in formulating that right,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that most of what was said would be of high quality

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: nor did they imagine it would be free of harmful things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What they correctly reasoned was that the benefit

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of leaving everything so it can be said exceeds the cost,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which everyone understands to be substantial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What I would say is they could not have anticipated

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the impact, the centrality of platforms

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: like YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: If they had, they would not have limited

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the First Amendment as they did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: They clearly understood that the power

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of the federal government was so great

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that it needed to be limited by granting explicitly

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the right of citizens to say anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: In fact, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: may be more powerful in this moment

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: than the federal government of their worst nightmares

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: could have been.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The power that these entities have to control thought

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and to shift civilization is so great

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that we need to have those same protections.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It doesn't mean that harmful things won't be said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but it means that nothing has changed

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: about the cost benefit analysis

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of building the right to censor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So if I were running YouTube,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the limit of what should be allowed

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is the limit of the law, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: If what you are doing is legal,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: then it should not be YouTube's place

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to limit what gets said or who gets to hear it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That is between speakers and audience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Will harm come from that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Of course it will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But will net harm come from it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: No, I don't believe it will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I believe that allowing everything to be said

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: does allow a process in which better ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: do come to the fore and win out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So you believe that in the end,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: when there's complete freedom to share ideas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that truth will win out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So what I've noticed, just as a brief side comment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that certain things become viral

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: irregardless of their truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I've noticed that things that are dramatic or funny,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: things that become memes don't have to be grounded in truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so what worries me there is that we basically

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: maximize for drama versus maximize for truth

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in a system where everything is free.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And that's worrying in the time of emergency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, yes, it's all worrying in time of emergency to be sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But I want you to notice that what you've happened on

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is actually an analog for a much deeper and older problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Human beings are the, we are not a blank slate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but we are the blankest slate that nature has ever devised.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And there's a reason for that, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's where our flexibility comes from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We have effectively, we are robots in which

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: a large fraction of the cognitive capacity has been,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: or of the behavioral capacity has been offloaded

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to the software layer, which gets written

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and rewritten over evolutionary time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That means effectively that much of what we are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in fact, the important part of what we are

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is housed in the cultural layer and the conscious layer

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and not in the hardware, hard coding layer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That layer is prone to make errors, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And anybody who's watched a child grow up

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: knows that children make absurd errors all the time, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That's part of the process, as we were discussing earlier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It is also true that as you look across

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: a field of people discussing things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: a lot of what is said is pure nonsense, it's garbage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But the tendency of garbage to emerge

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and even to spread in the short term

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: does not say that over the long term,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: what sticks is not the valuable ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So there's a high tendency for novelty

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to be created in the cultural space,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but there's also a high tendency for it to go extinct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And you have to keep that in mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's not like the genome, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Everything is happening at a much higher rate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Things are being created, they're being destroyed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I can't say that, you know, I mean, obviously,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: we've seen totalitarianism arise

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: many times and it's very destructive each time it does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So it's not like, hey, freedom to come up

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: with any idea you want hasn't produced a whole lot of carnage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But the question is over time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: does it produce more open, fairer, more decent societies?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I believe that it does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I can't prove it, but that does seem to be the pattern.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I believe so as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The thing is in the short term,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: freedom of speech is a very important thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Absolutely freedom of speech can be quite destructive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but you nevertheless have to hold on to that

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because in the long term,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think you and I, I guess, are optimistic

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in the sense that good ideas will win out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't know how strongly I believe that it will work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but I will say I haven't heard a better idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I would also point out that there's something

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: very significant in this question of the hubris involved

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in imagining that you're going to improve

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the discussion by censoring,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which is the majority of concepts at the fringe

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: are nonsense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That's automatic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But the heterodoxy at the fringe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which is indistinguishable at the beginning

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: from the nonsense ideas is the key to progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So if you decide, hey, the fringe is 99% garbage,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: let's just get rid of it, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Hey, that's a strong win.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We're getting rid of 99% garbage for 1% something or other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the point is, yeah,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but that 1% something or other is the key.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You're throwing out the key.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so that's what YouTube is doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Frankly, I think at the point

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that it started censoring my channel,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in the immediate aftermath of this major reversal

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of lab leak, it should have looked at itself and said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: well, what the hell are we doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Who are we censoring?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We're censoring somebody who was just right, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: In a conflict with the very same people

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: on whose behalf we are now censoring, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That should have caused them to wake up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So you said one approach, if you're on YouTube,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: was just basically let all videos go

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that do not violate the law.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, I should fix that, okay?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I believe that that is the basic principle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Eric makes an excellent point about the distinction

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: between ideas and personal attacks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: doxing, these other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I agree, there's no value in allowing people

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to destroy each other's lives,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194
