metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But I don't even wanna-

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, let me just say, I am also completely shocked

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that we did not get on high quality testing early

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and that we are still suffering from this even now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Because just the simple ability to track

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: where the virus moves between people

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: would tell us a lot about its mode of transmission,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which would allow us to protect ourselves better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Instead, that information was hard won

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and for no good reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I also find this mysterious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You've spoken with Eric Weinstein, your brother,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: on his podcast, The Portal, about the ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that eventually led to the paper you published,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: titled The Reserved Capacity Hypothesis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think first, can you explain this paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and the ideas that led up to it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Sure, easier to explain the conclusion of the paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: There's a question about why a creature

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that can replace its cells with new cells

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: grows feeble and inefficient with age.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We call that process, which is otherwise called aging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We call it senescence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And senescence in this paper, it is hypothesized,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is the unavoidable downside

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of a cancer prevention feature of our bodies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That each cell has a limit

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: on the number of times it can divide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: There are a few cells in the body that are exceptional,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but most of our cells can only divide

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: a limited number of times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That's called the Hayflick limit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the Hayflick limit reduces the ability

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of the organism to replace tissues.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It therefore results in a failure over time

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of maintenance and repair.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And that explains why we become decrepit as we grow old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The question was, why would that be,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: especially in light of the fact that the mechanism

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that seems to limit the ability of cells to reproduce

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is something called a telomere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Telomere is a, it's not a gene,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but it's a DNA sequence at the ends of our chromosomes

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that is just simply repetitive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the number of repeats functions like a counter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So there's a number of repeats that you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: after development is finished.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And then each time the cell divides,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: a little bit of telomere is lost.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And at the point that the telomere becomes critically short,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the cell stops dividing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: even though it still has the capacity to do so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Stops dividing and it starts transcribing different genes

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: than it did when it had more telomere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So what my work did was it looked at the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that the telomere shortening was being studied

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: by two different groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It was being studied by people who were interested

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in counteracting the aging process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And it was being studied in exactly the opposite fashion

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: by people who were interested in tumorigenesis and cancer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The thought being, because it was true

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that when one looked into tumors,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: they always had telomerase active.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That's the enzyme that lengthens our telomeres.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So those folks were interested in bringing about a halt

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to the lengthening of telomeres

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in order to counteract cancer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the folks who were studying the senescence process

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: were interested in lengthening telomeres

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in order to generate greater repair capacity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And my point was evolutionarily speaking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: this looks like a pleiotropic effect

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that the genes which create the tendency of the cells

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to be limited in their capacity to replace themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: are providing a benefit in youth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which is that we are largely free of tumors and cancer

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: at the inevitable late life cost

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that we grow feeble and inefficient and eventually die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And that matches a very old hypothesis

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in evolutionary theory by somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I was fortunate enough to know, George Williams,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: one of the great 20th century evolutionists

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: who argued that senescence would have to be caused

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: by pleiotropic genes that cause early life benefits

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: at unavoidable late life costs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And although this isn't the exact nature

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of the system he predicted,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: it matches what he was expecting in many regards

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to a shocking degree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That said, the focus of the paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is about the, well, let me just read the abstract.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We observed that captive rodent breeding protocols designed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: this is the end of the abstract.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: We observed that captive rodent breeding protocols

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: designed to increase reproductive output,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: simultaneously exerts strong selection

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: against reproductive senescence

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and virtually eliminates selection

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that would otherwise favor tumor suppression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: This appears to have greatly elongated

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the telomeres of laboratory mice

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: with their telomeric failsafe effectively disabled.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: These animals are unreliable models

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of normal senescence and tumor formation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So basically using these mice

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is not going to lead to the right kinds of conclusions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Safety tests employing these animals

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: likely overestimate cancer risks

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and underestimate tissue damage

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and consequent accelerated senescence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I think, especially with your discussion with Eric,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the conclusion of this paper has to do with the fact that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: like we shouldn't be using these mice

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to test the safety or to make conclusions

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: about cancer or senescence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Is that the basic takeaway?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Like basically saying that the length of these telomeres

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is an important variable to consider.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, let's put it this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think there was a reason that the world of scientists

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: who was working on telomeres

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: did not spot the pleiotropic relationship

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that was the key argument in my paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The reason they didn't spot it was that there was a result

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that everybody knew, which seemed inconsistent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The result was that mice have very long telomeres,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but they do not have very long lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Now we can talk about what the actual meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of don't have very long lives is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but in the end, I was confronted with a hypothesis

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that would explain a great many features

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of the way mammals and indeed vertebrates age,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but it was inconsistent with one result.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And at first I thought,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: maybe there's something wrong with the result.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Maybe this is one of these cases

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: where the result was achieved once through some bad protocol

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and everybody else was repeating it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Didn't turn out to be the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Many laboratories had established

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that mice had ultra long telomeres.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so I began to wonder whether or not there was something

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: about the breeding protocols that generated these mice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And what that would predict is that the mice

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that have long telomeres would be laboratory mice

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and that wild mice would not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And Carol Greider, who agreed to collaborate with me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: tested that hypothesis and showed that it was indeed true

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that wild derived mice, or at least mice that had been

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in captivity for a much shorter period of time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: did not have ultra long telomeres.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Now, what this implied though, as you read,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is that our breeding protocols generate lengthening

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of telomeres and the implication of that is that the animals

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that have these very long telomeres will be hyper prone

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to create tumors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: They will be extremely resistant to toxins

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because they have effectively an infinite capacity

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to replace any damaged tissue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so ironically, if you give one

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of these ultra long telomere lab mice a toxin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: if the toxin doesn't outright kill it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: it may actually increase its lifespan

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because it functions as a kind of chemotherapy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So the reason that chemotherapy works is

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that dividing cells are more vulnerable than cells

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that are not dividing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so if this mouse has effectively had its cancer

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: protection turned off and it has cells dividing too rapidly

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and you give it a toxin, you will slow

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: down its tumors faster than you harm its other tissues.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so you'll get a paradoxical result that actually some drug

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that's toxic seems to benefit the mouse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Now, I don't think that that was understood before I published

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: my paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Now, I'm pretty sure it has to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the problem is that this actually is a system

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that serves pharmaceutical companies

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that have the difficult job of bringing compounds to market,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: many of which will be toxic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Maybe all of them will be toxic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And these mice predispose our system

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to declare these toxic compounds safe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And in fact, I believe we've seen the errors that result

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: from using these mice a number of times,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: most famously with Vioxx, which turned

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: out to do conspicuous heart damage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Why do you think this paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and this idea has not gotten significant traction?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, my collaborator, Carol Greider, said something to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that rings in my ears to this day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: She initially, after she showed

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that laboratory mice have anomalously long telomeres

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and that wild mice don't have long telomeres, I asked her

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: where she was going to publish that result

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: so that I could cite it in my paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And she said that she was going to keep the result

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in-house rather than publish it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And at the time, I was a young graduate student.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I didn't really understand what she was saying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But in some sense, the knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that a model organism is broken in a way

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that creates the likelihood

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that certain results will be reliably generatable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You can publish a paper and make a big splash with such a thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Or you can exploit the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that you know how those models will misbehave

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and other people don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So there's a question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: If somebody is motivated cynically and what they want

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to do is appear to have deeper insight into biology

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because they predict things better than others do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: knowing where the flaw is so that your predictions come

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: out true is advantageous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: At the same time, I can't help but imagine

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that the pharmaceutical industry, when it figured

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: out that the mice were predisposed to suggest

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that drugs were safe, didn't leap to fix the problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because in some sense, it was the perfect cover

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: for the difficult job of bringing drugs to market

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and then discovering their actual toxicity profile, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: This made things look safer than they were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I believe a lot of profits have likely been generated

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: downstream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So to kind of play devil's advocate, it's also possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that this particular, the length of the telomeres is not a

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: strong variable for the conclusions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: for the drug development and for the conclusions that Carol

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and others have been studying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Is that, is it possible for that to be the case?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That this, like, so one reason she

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and others could be ignoring this is

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because it's not a strong variable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, I don't believe so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And in fact, at the point that I went to publish my paper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Carol published her result.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: She did so in a way that did not make a huge splash.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Did she, like, I apologize if I don't know how,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: what was the emphasis of her publication of that paper?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Was it purely just kind of showing data or is there more?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Because in your paper, there's a kind of more

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of a philosophical statement as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, my paper was motivated by interest

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in the evolutionary dynamics around senescence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I wasn't, you know, pursuing grants or anything like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I was just working on a puzzle I thought was interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Carol has, of course, gone on to win a Nobel Prize

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: for her co-discovery with Elizabeth Greider

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of telomerase, the enzyme that lengthens telomeres.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But anyway, she's a heavy hitter in the academic world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't know exactly what her purpose was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I do know that she told me she wasn't planning to publish.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I do know that I discovered that she

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: was in the process of publishing very late.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And when I asked her to send me the paper to see whether or not

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: she had put evidence in it that the hypothesis had come

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: from me, she grudgingly sent it to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And my name was nowhere mentioned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And she has, she broke contact at that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What it is that motivated her, I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But I don't think it can possibly be that this result

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is unimportant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The fact is, the reason I called her in the first place

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and established contact that generated our collaboration

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: was that she was a leading light in the field

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of telomeric studies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And because of that, this question

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: about whether the model organisms are distorting

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the understanding of the functioning of telomeres,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: it's central.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Do you feel like you've been, as a young graduate student,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: do you think Carol or do you think

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the scientific community broadly screwed you over in some way?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't think of it in those terms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: probably partly because it's not productive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But I have a complex relationship with this story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: On the one hand, I'm livid with Carol Greider for what she did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: She absolutely pretended that I didn't exist in this story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I don't think I was a threat to her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: My interest was, as an evolutionary biologist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I had made an evolutionary contribution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: She had tested a hypothesis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And frankly, I think it would have been better for her

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: if she had acknowledged what I had done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think it would have enhanced her work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I was, let's put it this way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: when I watched her Nobel lecture,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and I should say there's been a lot of confusion

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: about this Nobel stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I've never said that I should have gotten a Nobel Prize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: People have misportrayed that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: In listening to her lecture, I had

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: one of the most bizarre emotional experiences of my life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because she presented the work

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that resulted from my hypothesis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: She presented it as she had in her paper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: with no acknowledgement of where it had come from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And she had, in fact, portrayed the distortion

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of the telomeres as if it were a lucky fact,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because it allowed testing hypotheses

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that would otherwise not be testable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You have to understand, as a young scientist

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to watch work that you have done presented

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: in what's surely the most important lecture of her career,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: it's thrilling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It was thrilling to see her figures projected

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: on the screen there, to have been part of work

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that was important enough for that felt great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And of course, to be erased from the story

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: felt absolutely terrible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So anyway, that's sort of where I am with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: My sense is, what I'm really troubled by in the story

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is the fact that, as far as I know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: the flaw with the mice has not been addressed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And actually, Eric did some looking into this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: He tried to establish, by calling the Jax Lab

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and trying to ascertain what had happened with the colonies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: whether any change in protocol had occurred.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And he couldn't get anywhere.

body.input: that I was in.

body.input: But that's not what happened here.

body.input: and began to be an opposing force to my work.

body.input: life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: along this line?

body.input: That's often the dynamic of that fascinating space,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But then the way to it's almost an opportunity

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Did you consider that possible trajectory?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: A couple of things to say about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: One, this work was not central for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I took a year on the T. Lemure project

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because something fascinating occurred to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I pursued it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the more I pursued it, the clearer it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: There was something there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But it wasn't the focus of my graduate work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I didn't want to become a T. Lemure researcher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What I want to do is to be an evolutionary biologist who

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: upgrades the toolkit of evolutionary concepts

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: so that we can see more clearly how organisms function and why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And T. Lemure's was a proof of concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That paper was a proof of concept

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that the toolkit in question works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: As for the need to pursue it further,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think it's kind of absurd.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And you're not the first person to say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: maybe that was the way to go about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But the basic point is, look, the work was good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It turned out to be highly predictive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Frankly, the model of senescence that I presented

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is now widely accepted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I don't feel any misgivings at all

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: about having spent a year on it, said my piece,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and moved on to other things, which frankly I think are bigger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think there's a lot of good to be done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And it would be a waste to get overly narrowly focused.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: There's so many ways through this space of science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the most common ways is just publish a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's published a lot of papers, these incremental work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and exploring the space, kind of like ants looking for food.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You're tossing out a bunch of different ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Some of them could be brilliant breakthrough ideas, nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Some of them are more confidence kind of publications,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Did you consider that kind of path in science?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Of course I considered it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But I must say, the experience of having my first encounter

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: with the process of peer review be this story, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: was frankly a debacle from one end to the other with respect

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: to the process of publishing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It was not a very good sales pitch

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: for trying to make a difference to publication.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I would point out part of what I ran into,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and I think frankly part of what explains Carol's behavior,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is that in some parts of science,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: there is this dynamic where PIs parasitize their underlings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And if you're very, very good, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: rise to the level where one day, instead of being parasitized,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: you get to parasitize others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Now I find that scientifically despicable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And it wasn't the culture of the lab I grew up in at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: My lab, in fact the PI, Dick Alexander, who is now gone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but who was an incredible mind and a great human being,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: he didn't want his graduate students working

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: on the same topics he was on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Not because it wouldn't have been useful and exciting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but because in effect, he did not

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: want any confusion about who had done what,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because he was a great mentor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the idea was actually a great mentor is not

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: stealing ideas, and you don't want people

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: thinking that they are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So anyway, my point would be I wasn't up for being

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194
