body.input: my calling would have been inventing stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I really enjoy that too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I get what you're saying about the analogy quite well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: As far as the martyrdom thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I understand the drug you're talking about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and I've seen it more than I've felt it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I do, if I'm just to be completely candid,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and that this question is so good,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: it deserves a candid answer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I do like the fight, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I like fighting against people I don't respect,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and I like winning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But I have no interest in martyrdom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: One of the reasons I have no interest in martyrdom

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is that I'm having too good a time, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I very much enjoy my life, and...

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That's such a good answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I have a wonderful wife, I have amazing children,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I live in a lovely place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't want to exit any quicker than I have to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That said, I also believe in things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and a willingness to exit, if that's the only way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is not exactly inviting martyrdom,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but it is an acceptance that fighting is dangerous,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and going up against powerful forces

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: means who knows what will come of it, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I have the sense that the thing is out there

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that used to kill inconvenient people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't think that's how it's done anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's primarily done through destroying them reputationally,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which is not something I relish the possibility of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But there's a difference between a willingness to face the hazard

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: rather than a desire to face it because of the thrill, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: For me, the thrill is in fighting when I'm in the right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I feel that that is a worthwhile way to take what I see as the kind of brutality

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that is built into men and to channel it to something useful, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: If it is not channeled into something useful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: it will be channeled into something else,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: so it damn well better be channeled into something useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's not motivated by fame or popularity, those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You're just making me realize that enjoying the fight,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: fighting the powerful and idea that you believe is right,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is a kind of optimism for the human spirit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's like, we can win this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's almost like you're turning into action, into personal action,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: into this hope for humanity by saying, we can win this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That makes you feel good about the rest of humanity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that if there's people like me, then we're going to be okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Even if your ideas might be wrong or not, but if you believe they're right

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and you're fighting the powerful against all odds, then we're going to be okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: If I were to project, because I enjoy the fight as well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think that's what brings me joy, is it's almost like optimism in action.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, it's a little different for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I recognize you, your construction is familiar even if it isn't mine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: For me, I actually expect us not to be okay, and I'm not okay with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But what's really important, if I feel, like what I've said is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't know of any reason that it's too late.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: As far as I know, we could still save humanity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and we could get to the fourth frontier or something akin to it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but I expect us not to, I expect us to fuck it up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't like that thought, but I've looked into the abyss,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and I've done my calculations, and the number of ways we could not succeed are many,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and the number of ways that we could manage to get out of this very dangerous phase of history is small.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But the thing I don't have to worry about is that I didn't do enough,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: that I was a coward, that I prioritized other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: At the end of the day, I think I will be able to say to myself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and in fact, the thing that allows me to sleep is that when I saw clearly what needed to be done,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I tried to do it to the extent that it was in my power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And if we fail, as I expect us to, I can't say, well, geez, that's on me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Frankly, I regard what I just said to you as something like a personality defect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I'm trying to free myself from the sense that this is my fault.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: On the other hand, my guess is that personality defect is probably good for humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's a good one for me to have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The externalities of it are positive, so I don't feel too bad about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah, that's funny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So yeah, our perspective on the world are different, but they rhyme, like you said.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I've also looked into the abyss, and it kind of smiled nervously back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I have a more optimistic sense that we're going to win more than likely we're going to be OK.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I'm right there with you, brother.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I'm hoping you're right. I'm expecting me to be right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But back to Eric, you had a wonderful conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: In that conversation, he played the big brother role, and he was very happy about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: He was self-congratulatory about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Can you talk to the ways in which Eric made you a better man throughout your life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah, hell yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I mean, for one thing, Eric and I are interestingly similar in some ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and radically different in some other ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's often a matter of fascination to people who know us both,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because almost always people meet one of us first, and they sort of get used to that thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and then they meet the other, and it throws the model into chaos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But I had a great advantage, which is I came second.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So although it was kind of a pain in the ass to be born into a world that had Eric in it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because he's a force of nature, it was also terrifically useful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: because he was a very awesome older brother who made interesting mistakes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: learned from them, and conveyed the wisdom of what he had discovered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And that was, I don't know who else ends up so lucky as to have that kind of person blazing the trail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And also, probably my hypothesis for what birth order effects are is that they're actually adaptive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That the reason that a second born is different than a first born

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: is that they're not born into a world with the same niches in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so the thing about Eric is he's been completely dominant in the realm of fundamental thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Like what he's fascinated by is the fundamental of fundamentals, and he's excellent at it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: which meant that I was born into a world where somebody was becoming excellent in that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and for me to be anywhere near the fundamental of fundamentals was going to be pointless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I was going to be playing second fiddle forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I think that that actually drove me to the other end of the continuum between fundamental and emergent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so I became fascinated with biology and have been since I was three years old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think Eric drove that, and I have to thank him for it because, you know, I mean...

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I never thought of... So Eric drives towards the fundamental, and you drive towards the emergent, the physics and the biology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You drive opposite ends of the continuum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And as Eric would be quick to point out if he was sitting here, I treat the emergent layer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I seek the fundamentals in it, which is sort of an echo of Eric's style of thinking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but applied to the very far complexity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So he's overpoweringly argues for the importance of physics, the fundamental of the fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: He's not here to defend himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Is there an argument to be made against that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Or biology, the emergent, the study of the thing that emerged when the fundamental acts at the cosmic scale

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: and then builds the beautiful thing that is us is much more important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Psychology, biology, the systems that we're actually interacting with in this human world

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: are much more important to understand than low-level theories of quantum mechanics and general relativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah, I can't say that one is more important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think there's probably a different time scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think understanding the emergent layer is more often useful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but the bang for the buck at the far fundamental layer may be much greater.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So for example, the fourth frontier, I'm pretty sure it's going to have to be fusion powered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't think anything else will do it, but once you had fusion power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: assuming we didn't just dump fusion power on the market the way we would be likely to if it was invented usefully tomorrow,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: but if we had fusion power and we had a little bit more wisdom than we have, you could do an awful lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And that's not going to come from people like me who look at dynamics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Can I argue against that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Please.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think the way to unlock fusion power is through artificial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I think most of the breakthrough ideas in the futures of science will be developed by AI systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I think in order to build intelligent AI systems, you have to be a scholar of the fundamental of the emergent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: of biology, of the neuroscience, of the way the brain works, of intelligence, of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And those things, at least directly, don't have anything to do with physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, you're making me a little bit sad because my addiction to the aha moment thing is incompatible with outsourcing that job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't want to outsource that thing to the AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And actually, I've seen this happen before because some of the people who trained Heather and me were phylogenetic systematists, Arnold Kluge in particular.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And the problem with systematics is that to do it right when your technology is primitive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: you have to be deeply embedded in the philosophical and the logical, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Your method has to be based in the highest level of rigor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Once you can sequence genes, genes can spit so much data at you that you can overwhelm high quality work with just lots and lots and lots of automated work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so in some sense, there's like a generation of phylogenetic systematists who are the last of the greats because what's replacing them is sequencers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So anyway, maybe you're right about the AI.

body.input: Hmm. Hell yeah. Hell yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And, you know, I'd love him if he was just my brother, but he's also awesome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I love him and I love him for who he is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So let me ask you about back to your book, Hunter Gatherer's Guide to the 21st Century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I can't wait both for the book and the videos you do on the book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That's really exciting that there's like a structured, organized way to present this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: A kind of from an evolutionary biology perspective, a guide for the future using our past as the fundamental, the emergent way to present a picture of the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Let me ask you about something that, you know, I think about a little bit in this modern world, which is monogamy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I personally value monogamy. One girl, ride or die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: There you go. Ride or die. No, that's exactly it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But that said, I don't know what's the right way to approach this, but from an evolutionary biology perspective or from just looking at modern society, that seems to be an idea that's not, what's the right way to put it, flourishing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It is waning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I suppose based on your reaction, you're also a supporter of monogamy or you value monogamy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Are you and I just delusional?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What can you say about monogamy from the context of your book, from the context of evolutionary biology, from the context of being human?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah, I can say that I fully believe that we are actually enlightened and that although monogamy is waning, that it is not waning because there is a superior system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It is waning for predictable other reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So let us just say it is there is a lot of pre-trans fallacy here where people go through a phase where they recognize that actually we know a lot about the evolution of monogamy and we can tell from the fact that humans are somewhat sexually dimorphic, that there has been a lot of polygyny in human history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And in fact, most of human history was largely polygynous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But it is also the case that most of the people on earth today belong to civilizations that are at least nominally monogamous and have practiced monogamy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And that's not anti-evolutionary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What that is, is part of what I mentioned before, where human beings can swap out their software program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And different mating patterns are favored in different periods of history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I would argue that the benefit of monogamy, the primary one that drives the evolution of monogamous patterns in humans, is that it brings all adults into child rearing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Now the reason that that matters is because human babies are very labor intensive. In order to raise them properly, having two parents is a huge asset. And having more than two parents, having an extended family also is very important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But what that means is that for a population that is expanding, a monogamous mating system makes sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It makes sense because it means that the number of offspring that can be raised is elevated. It's elevated because all potential parents are involved in parenting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Whereas if you sideline a bunch of males by having a polygynous system in which one male has many females, which is typically the way that works, what you do is you sideline all those males, which means the total amount of parental effort is lower and the population can't grow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So what I'm arguing is that you should expect to see populations that face the possibility of expansion endorse monogamy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And at the point that they have reached carrying capacity, you should expect to see polygyny break back out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And what we are seeing is a kind of false sophistication around polyamory, which will end up breaking down into polygyny, which will not be in the interests of most people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Really the only people whose interests it could be argued to be in would be the very small number of males at the top who have many partners and everybody else suffers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Is it possible to make the argument if we focus in on those males at the quote unquote top with many female partners, is it possible to say that that's a suboptimal life, that a single partner is the optimal life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, it depends what you mean. I have a feeling that you and I wouldn't have to go very far to figure out that what might be evolutionarily optimal doesn't match my values as a person, and I'm sure it doesn't match yours either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Can we try to dig into that gap between those two?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Sure. I mean, we can do it very simply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Selection might favor your engaging in war against a defenseless enemy or genocide, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's not hard to figure out how that might put your genes at advantage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't know about you, Lex. I'm not getting involved in no genocide. It's not going to happen. I won't do it. I will do anything to avoid it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So some part of me has decided that my conscious self and the values that I hold trump my evolutionary self.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And once you figure out that in some extreme case that's true, and then you realize that that means it must be possible in many other cases, and you start going through all of the things that selection would favor, and you realize that a fair fraction of the time, actually you're not up for this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You don't want to be some robot on a mission that involves genocide when necessary. You want to be your own person and accomplish things that you think are valuable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so among those are not advocating. Let's suppose you were in a position to be one of those males at the top of a polygynous system. We both know why that would be rewarding, right? But we also both recognize that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Do we?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah, sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Lots of sex?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Okay, what else?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Lots of sex and lots of variety, right? So look, every red-blooded American slash Russian male could understand why that's appealing, right? On the other hand, it is up against an alternative, which is having a partner with whom one is bonded especially closely, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so-

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's a love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Right. Well, you know, I don't want to straw man the polygyny position. Obviously, polygyny is complex, and there's nothing that stops a man presumably from loving multiple partners and from them loving him back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But in terms of, you know, if love is your thing, there's a question about, okay, what is the quality of love if it is divided over multiple partners, right? And what is the net consequence for love in a society when multiple people will be frozen out for every individual male in this case who has it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And what I would argue is, and you know, this is weird to even talk about, but this is partially me just talking from personal experience. I think there actually is a monogamy program in us, and it's not automatic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But if you take it seriously, you can find it. And frankly, marriage, and it doesn't have to be marriage, but whatever it is that results in a lifelong bond with a partner has gotten a very bad rap. You know, it's the butt of too many jokes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But the truth is, it's hugely rewarding. It's not easy. But if you know that you're looking for something, right, if you know that the objective actually exists, and it's not some utopian fantasy that can't be found, if you know that there's some real world, you know, warts and all version of it, then you might actually think, hey, that is something I want. And you might pursue it. And my guess is you'd be very happy when you find it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think there is getting to the fundamentals of the emergent. I feel like there is some kind of physics of love. So one, there's a conservation thing going on. So if you have like many partners, yeah, in theory, you should be able to love all of them deeply. But it seems like in reality that love gets split.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Now, there's another law that's interesting in terms of monogamy. I don't know if it's the physics level, but if you are in a monogamous relationship by choice, and almost as in slight rebellion to social norms, that's much more powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Like if you choose that one partnership, that's also more powerful. If like everybody's in a monogamous, there's this pressure to be married and this pressure of society, that's different, because that's almost like a constraint on your freedom that is enforced by something other than your own ideals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's by somebody else. When you yourself choose to, I guess, create these constraints, that enriches that love. So there's some kind of love function, like E equals MC squared, but for love, that I feel like if you have less partners and it's done by choice, that can maximize that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And that love can transcend the biology, transcend the evolutionary biology forces that have to do much more with survival and all those kinds of things. It can transcend to take us to a richer experience, which we have the luxury of having, exploring, of happiness, of joy, of fulfillment, all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Totally agree with this. And there's no question that by choice, when there are other choices, imbues it with meaning that it might not otherwise have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I would also say, I'm really struck by, and I have a hard time not feeling terrible sadness over what younger people are coming to think about this topic. I think they're missing something so important and so hard to phrase, and they don't even know that they're missing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: They might know that they're unhappy, but they don't understand what it is they're even looking for because nobody's really been honest with them about what their choices are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I have to say, if I was a young person or if I was advising a young person, which I used to do, again, a million years ago when I was a college professor four years ago, but I used to talk to students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I knew my students really well, and they would ask questions about this, and they were always curious because Heather and I seemed to have a good relationship, and many of them knew both of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So they would talk to us about this. If I was advising somebody, I would say, do not bypass the possibility that what you are supposed to do is find somebody worthy, somebody who can handle it, somebody who you are compatible with, and that you don't have to be perfectly compatible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's not about dating until you find the one. It's about finding somebody whose underlying values and viewpoint are complementary to yours, sufficient that you fall in love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: If you find that person, opt out together. Get out of this damn system that's telling you what's sophisticated to think about love and romance and sex. Ignore it together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That's the key, and I believe you'll end up laughing in the end if you do it. You'll discover, wow, that's a hellscape that I opted out of, and this thing I opted into, complicated, difficult, worth it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Nothing that's worth it is ever not difficult, so we should even just skip the whole statement about difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah, all right. I want to be honest. It's not like, oh, it's nonstop joy. No, it's freaking complex, but worth it? No question in my mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Is there advice outside of love that you can give to young people? You were a million years ago a professor. Is there advice you can give to young people, high schoolers, college students about career, about life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah, but they're not going to like it because it's not easy to operationalize. This was a problem when I was a college professor, too. People would ask me what they should do. Should they go to graduate school?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I had almost nothing useful to say because the job market and the market of pre-job training and all of that, these things are all so distorted and corrupt that I didn't want to point anybody to anything because it's all broken, and I would tell them that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But I would say that results in a kind of meta-level advice that I do think is useful. You don't know what's coming. You don't know where the opportunities will be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You should invest in tools rather than knowledge, right? To the extent that you can do things, you can repurpose that no matter what the future brings to the extent that if you, as a robot guy, you've got the skills of a robot guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Now, if civilization failed and the stuff of robot building disappeared with it, you'd still have the mind of a robot guy, and the mind of a robot guy can retool around all kinds of things, whether you're forced to work with fibers that are made into ropes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Your mechanical mind would be useful in all kinds of places. So invest in tools like that that can be easily repurposed, and invest in combinations of tools. If civilization keeps limping along, you're going to be up against all sorts of people who have studied the things that you studied.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: If you think, hey, computer programming is really, really cool, and you pick up computer programming, guess what? You just entered a large group of people who have that skill, and many of them will be better than you, almost certainly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: On the other hand, if you combine that with something else that's very rarely combined with it, if you have, I don't know if it's carpentry and computer programming, if you take combinations of things that are, even if they're both common, but they're not commonly found together, then those combinations create a rarefied space where you inhabit it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Even if the things don't even really touch, but nonetheless, they create a mind in which the two things are live, and you can move back and forth between them and step out of your own perspective by moving from one to the other, that will increase what you can see and the quality of your tools.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Anyway, that isn't useful advice. It doesn't tell you whether you should go to graduate school or not, but it does tell you the one thing we can say for certain about the future is that it's uncertain, and so prepare for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And like you said, there's cool things to be discovered in the intersection of fields and ideas, and I would look at grad school that way, actually, if you do go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I see, I mean, this is such a, like every course in grad school, undergrad too, was like this little journey that you're on that explores a particular field, and it's not immediately obvious how useful it is, but it allows you to discover intersections between that thing and some other thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So you're bringing to the table these pieces of knowledge, some of which, when intersected, might create a niche that's completely novel, unique, and will bring you joy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I mean, I took a huge number of courses in theoretical computer science. Most of them seem useless, but they totally changed the way I see the world in ways that I'm not prepared or is a little bit difficult to kind of make explicit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But taken together, they've allowed me to see, for example, the world of robotics totally different and different from many of my colleagues and friends and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I think that's a good way to see if you go to grad school as an opportunity to explore intersections of fields, even if the individual fields seem useless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah, and useless doesn't mean useless, right? Useless means not directly applicable, but a good useless course can be the best one you ever took.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah, I took a course on James Joyce, and that was truly useless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, I took immunobiology in the medical school when I was at Penn as, I guess I would have been a freshman or a sophomore. I wasn't supposed to be in this class. It blew my goddamn mind, and it still does, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I mean, we had this, I don't even know who it was, but we had this great professor who was like highly placed in the world of immunobiology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You know, the course is called immunobiology, not immunology, immunobiology. It had the right focus. And as I recall it, the professor stood sideways to the chalkboard staring off into space, literally stroking his beard with this bemused look on his face through the entire lecture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And you know, you had all these medical students who were so furiously writing notes that I don't even think they were noticing the person delivering this thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But you know, I got what this guy was smiling about. It was like so what he was describing, you know, adaptive immunity is so marvelous, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That it was like almost a privilege to even be saying it to a room full of people who were listening, you know?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But anyway, yeah, I took that course. And you know, lo and behold, COVID.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That's not going to be useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, yeah, suddenly it's front and center. And wow, am I glad I took it. But anyway, yeah, useless courses are great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And actually, Eric gave me one of the greater pieces of advice, at least for college that anyone's ever given, which was don't worry about the prereqs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Take it anyway, right? But now I don't even know if kids can do this now because the prereqs are now enforced by a computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But back in the day, if you didn't mention that you didn't have the prereqs, nobody stopped you from taking the course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And what he told me, which I didn't know, was that often the advanced courses are easier in some way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The material is complex. But you know, it's not like intro bio where you're learning a thousand things at once, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's like focused on something. So if you dedicate yourself, you can you can pull it off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah. Stay with an idea for many weeks at a time. And it's ultimately rewarding and not as difficult as it looks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Can I ask you a ridiculous question?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Please.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What do you think is the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, I feel terrible having to give you the answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I realize you asked the question, but if I tell you, you're going to again feel bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't want to do that. But look, there's two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: There can be a disappointment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: No, it's going to be a horror. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Because we actually know the answer to the question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Oh, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's completely meaningless. There is nothing that we can do that escapes the heat death of the universe or whatever it is that happens at the end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And we're not going to make it there anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But even if you were optimistic about our ability to escape every existential hazard indefinitely, ultimately it's all for not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And we know it. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That said, once you stare into that abyss and then it stares back and laughs or whatever happens, then the question is, okay, given that, can I relax a little bit and figure out, well, what would make sense if that were true?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I think there's something very clear to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I think if you do all of the, you know, if I just take the values that I'm sure we share and extrapolate from them, I think the following thing is actually a moral imperative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Being a human and having opportunity is absolutely fucking awesome. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: A lot of people don't make use of the opportunity and a lot of people don't have opportunity. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: They get to be human, but they're too constrained by keeping a roof over their heads to really be free.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But being a free human is fantastic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And being a free human on this beautiful planet, crippled as it may be, is unparalleled.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I mean, what could be better? How lucky are we that we get that? Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So if that's true, that it is awesome to be human and to be free, then surely it is our obligation to deliver that opportunity to as many people as we can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And how do you do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Well, I think I know what job one is. Job one is we have to get sustainable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: The way to get the maximum number of humans to have that opportunity to be both here and free is to make sure that there isn't a limit on how long we can keep doing this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That effectively requires us to reach sustainability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And then at sustainability, you could have a horror show of sustainability. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You could have a totalitarian sustainability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: That's not the objective. The objective is to liberate people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so the question, the whole Fourth Frontier question, frankly, is how do you get to a sustainable and indefinitely sustainable state in which people feel liberated, in which they are liberated to pursue the things that actually matter, to pursue beauty, truth, compassion, connection, all of those things that we could list as unalloyed goods.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Those are the things that people should be most liberated to do in a system that really functions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And anyway, my point is, I don't know how precise that calculation is, but I'm pretty sure it's not wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: It's accurate enough. And if it is accurate enough, then the point is, okay, well, there's no ultimate meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: But the proximate meaning is that one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: How many people can we get to have this wonderful experience that we've gotten to have? Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And there's no way that's so wrong that if I invest my life in it, that I'm making some big error.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Sure of that. Life is awesome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And we want to spread the awesome as much as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Yeah. You sum it up that way. Spread the awesome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Spread the awesome. So that's the Fourth Frontier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And if that fails, if the Fourth Frontier fails, the Fifth Frontier will be defined by robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And hopefully they'll learn the lessons of the mistakes that the humans made and build a better world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I hope they're very happy here and that they do a better job with the place than we did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Brett, I can't believe it took us this long to talk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: As I mentioned to you before that we haven't actually spoken, I think, at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I've always felt that we're already friends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I don't know how that works because I've listened to your podcast a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I've also sort of love your brother.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And so it was like we've known each other for the longest time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I hope we can be friends and talk often again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: I hope that you get a chance to meet some of my robot friends as well and fall in love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: And I'm so glad that you love robots as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So we get to share in that love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So I can't wait for us to interact together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: So we went from talking about some of the worst failures of humanity to some of the most beautiful aspects of humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: What else can you ask for from a conversation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Thank you so much for talking to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: You know, Alex, I feel the same way towards you and I really appreciate it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: This has been a lot of fun and I'm looking forward to our next one.

body.input: Thanks for listening to this conversation with Brett Weinstein.

body.input: And now let me leave you with some words from Charles Darwin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bret Weinstein: Truth, Science, and Censorship in the Time of a Pandemic | Lex Fridman Podcast #194

body.input: Ignorance more frequently begets confidence than does knowledge. It is those who know little, not those who know much, who so positively assert that this or that problem will never be solved by science.

body.input: So how do we connect up the people who have real needs

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: If we look farther into the future,

body.input: You know, really?

body.input: Like, and then it goes back in a box, you know?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: So on that point,

body.input: if we continue looking a little bit into the future,

body.input: and does improve our lives

body.input: And even, let me cautiously say the C word, consciousness

body.input: and even fear of mortality.

body.input: do you think it needs to have those aspects?

body.input: Or can it remain simply a machine learning tool

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: that learns from data of behavior

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: that learns to make us based on previous patterns

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: feel better?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: Or does it need those elements of consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: It depends on your goals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: It needs a gorgeous body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: It needs to act like it has consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: It needs to act like it has emotion, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: Because that's what sells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: That's what's gonna get me to show up and enjoy the movie.

body.input: Okay.

body.input: In real life, does it need all that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: Well, if you've read Orson Scott Card, Ender's Game,

body.input: Speaker for the Dead,

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: it could just be like a little voice in your earring, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: And you could have an intimate relationship

body.input: But that doesn't make this compelling of a movie, right?

body.input: I mean, we already think it's kind of weird

body.input: when a guy looks like he's talking to himself on the train,

body.input: even though it's earbuds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: So we have these, embodied is more powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

body.input: Embodied when you compare interactions

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24

metadata.title: Podcast: Rosalind Picard: Affective Computing, Emotion, Privacy, and Health | Lex Fridman Podcast #24
